title: 第五章 解决绿皮第六章 雪迪艾兰的魅力
content_zh:
颜铁龙对自己释放补助魔法，看到战场女冒险者一个人使用鞭将自己伙伴从救出危险状况，可也导致她陷入二头绿皮角牙兽的夹击中，陷入苦战中。
“铁龙，那个女冒险者是一位大美女啊！你！”克米迪斯看到女冒险者被绿皮角牙兽大棒扫掉头套，露出了美丽金色秀发以及精致美丽的面容就对身边的颜铁龙说到，并转头看向身边的颜铁龙，却发现已经没有他的人影了。
颜铁龙快以风羽飘步急速冲向二只绿皮角牙兽夹击女冒险者那边，可惜在在他经过十几位新人护卫战斗圈里，被一只突然出现绿皮皮小鬼挡路，让不耐烦的颜铁龙一脚踢飞同时说道：“不要碍事，给我通通闪开。”，而周围新人护卫看到颜铁龙如此轻松解决绿皮皮小鬼都有点目登口呆身体不由自主给颜铁龙让开一条没有阻碍的道路。
颜铁龙快速来到女冒险者身边，在女冒险者还没有反应过来挡住向她棒击的绿皮角牙兽，同时还有余力的对女冒险者激请道：“美丽的女士，我叫颜铁龙，是一名深之冒险者，不知道等一下到古羽镇能不能请您喝一杯呢？”。
“恩！！”被穿着骑士铠甲年轻人叫做兰姨美女冒险者对突然出现颜铁龙并帮他挡住绿皮角牙兽攻击十分意外。
在兰姨冒险者还没有回答颜铁龙的激请，在她后面穿着骑士铠甲年轻人大声排斥颜铁龙道：“像你这种粗鲁的冒险者怎么可以激请我家兰姨！”。
“小子！我激请的是这位美女，而不是你，就算你跟他相熟，最终决定要不要接受我的激请是这位美女，而不是你。”颜铁龙用剑挡在绿皮角牙兽大棒，还有闲情逸致对穿着骑士铠甲年轻人道。
“狮特！还有阁下你，现在战斗中有事等一下在说！”被骑士铠甲年轻人叫做兰姨的冒险者躲掉绿皮角牙兽的棒击大声道。
“既然美女发话了，那么就请你这些碍事的家伙给我退场吧。”颜铁龙听到美女冒险者的话，眼神变的尖锐对着跟自己较力的绿皮角牙兽道。
“啊！！！”颜铁龙大吼一声加大自己剑力量，将跟自己较力的绿皮角牙兽挣开，在绿皮角牙兽还没站稳，颜铁龙以风羽剑术进行追击，并在绿皮角牙兽还没反应过来就被颜铁龙一剑从腰部劈成两段。
“风刃！”同时颜铁龙攻击并没有结束，在将绿皮角牙两段之前，他已经在默念风系魔法咒语，在他完成对眼前绿皮角牙兽劈成两段后，直接左手释放已经风系魔法，放出十几道风刃精准的经过穿着骑士铠甲年轻人身后射向另一头没有任何甲的绿皮角牙兽脖子部位。
绿皮角牙兽被颜铁龙风刃击中脖子部位，直接导致绿皮角牙兽脖子血静脉被切断，绿皮角牙兽痛苦用自己手捂着自己伤口防止绿色血液流出，可惜已经没有用了，根本止不住，最后倒下流血过多而死。
“啊～！”最后一头绿皮角牙兽看到自己同伴被一个人类快速解决，身体颤抖的吼叫了一声，然后快速转身逃跑。
“你以为你还跑的掉，给我去死！”颜铁龙看到最后一头绿皮角牙兽头也不回的逃跑就捡起身边已经死掉绿皮角牙兽的大木棒，直接投向逃跑的绿皮角牙兽。
不知道是绿皮角牙兽运气不好，还是颜铁龙的命中率太高，颜铁龙投的大木棒十分完美命中绿皮角牙兽的后脑勺，绿皮角牙兽被击中后，向前跑两步，直接倒地晕死过去。
颜铁龙看着倒地不起的绿皮角牙兽就走到身边，直接一剑将不知道死活的绿皮角牙兽脑袋斩了下来，并说道：“事后补刀可是十分重要的事情，这下子一两个月的生活费有了。”。
“你这个嗜血狂徒！它已经没有战斗能力，你为什么还要杀它！”当颜铁龙走向金发美女之时穿着骑士铠甲年轻人《女》带着不满以及质问的语气对路过她身边的颜铁龙问道。
颜铁龙听到穿着骑士铠甲年轻人《女》质问就停下深深看着穿着骑士铠甲年轻人说道：“小子，你骑士小说看多了吧？还有我觉得你并不适合这里，回到你大城市继续当你的贵族才是你正确的选择。”。
“我要跟你决斗！”穿着骑士铠甲年轻人《女》听到颜铁龙话愤怒，脱下手套扔向颜铁龙并大声道。
“呵呵，等你什么时候，一个人解决三头以上绿皮角牙兽，在来找我决斗吧，我对蹂躏菜鸟没兴趣，不过像你这样拥有洁白双手的贵族公子，应该不可能达到那种程度。”颜铁龙捡起地上的铠甲手套，并注意穿着骑士铠甲年轻人《女》洁白无暇的双手，就微笑将手套扔还给穿骑士铠甲年轻人《女》道。

“你！”穿着骑士铠甲年轻人看着经过她身边颜铁龙无话可说，毕竟她也清楚自己的实力跟眼前粗鲁的冒险者差距。
颜铁龙突然看到地上一朵不知名的小红色花就直接摘取并来到美女冒险者面前，将小红花送到美女冒险者面前说道：“美女的女士，这朵鲜花很您很配，希望您能喜欢。”。
“谢谢！”被穿着骑士铠甲年轻人《女》称之兰姨成熟金发美女接过小红花，轻轻闻了闻小红花，露出微笑的笑容感谢道。
颜铁龙看到眼前美女，露出灿烂微笑的样子，他的内心出现一匹狼，并向不停吼叫，而他表面十分绅士的对眼前美女询问道：“美丽的女士，不知道我刚刚的提议，你愿意接受我激请吗？”。
“抱歉！我对于不成熟男孩子不感兴趣，谢谢你花。”被穿着骑士铠甲年轻人称之兰姨看了看颜铁龙十分绅士的表情神情变的严肃道并将小红花还给颜铁龙手中，然后离开向车队走去。
“铁龙！铁龙！！”而颜铁龙听到自己心意的美女的话，内心的大红心直接碎裂一地，同时他外表被打击成跟石化一样维持刚刚的动作，就连克米迪恩跑到他身边喊他名字都没有听道。
“活该！”穿着骑士铠甲年轻人《女》经过颜铁龙身边看到他这样子幸灾乐祸道。
“小南！帮我将水袋拿过来。”克米迪斯看自己不管怎么叫，都没有反应就对车队的同伴喊道。
content_en:
Yan Tielong cast auxiliary magic on himself and saw a female adventurer on the battlefield using a whip to rescue her partner from a dangerous situation, but it also caused her to fall into the trap of two green-skinned horned beasts and fall into a bitter battle.
"Tielong, that female adventurer is a great beauty! You!" Kermedis said to Yan Tielong next to him when he saw the female adventurer's hood being swept away by the green-skinned horned beast's big stick, revealing her beautiful golden hair and delicate and beautiful face. He turned to look at Yan Tielong beside him, but found that he was no longer there.
Yan Tielong quickly rushed towards the two green-skinned horned beasts who were flanking the female adventurer with his wind-feathered steps. Unfortunately, as he was passing through a dozen newcomers to guard the battle circle, a green-skinned imp suddenly appeared in the way, causing the impatient Yan Tielong to kick him. Kick away and said at the same time: "Don't get in the way, get out of my way." The new guards around him were a little dumbfounded when they saw Yan Tielong deal with the green-skinned imp so easily, and their bodies involuntarily gave way to an unobstructed path for Yan Tielong.
Yan Tielong quickly came to the female adventurer. Before the female adventurer could react, she blocked the green-skinned horned beast that was attacking her. At the same time, he still had enough energy to urge the female adventurer: "Beautiful lady, my name is Yan Tielong. I am a deep adventurer. I wonder if I can buy you a drink when I get to Guyu Town later?".
"Yeah!!" The beautiful adventurer, who was called Auntie Lan by the young man wearing knight armor, was very surprised when Yan Tielong suddenly appeared and helped him block the attack of the green-skinned horned beast.
Before Aunt Lan could answer Yan Tielong's invitation, a young man wearing a knight's armor loudly rejected Yan Tielong and said, "How can a rude adventurer like you provoke my Aunt Lan!"
"Boy! It's this beauty I invited, not you. Even if you are familiar with her, it is this beauty, not you, who ultimately decides whether to accept my invitation." Yan Tielong used his sword to block the big club of the green-skinned horned beast, and leisurely said to the young man wearing knight armor.
"Shite! And you, Your Excellency, we have something to talk about during the battle now!" The adventurer, who was called Auntie Lan by the young man in knight armor, said loudly as she dodged the blow of the green-skinned horned tooth beast.
"Now that the beauty has spoken, please get out of the way, you guys who are in the way." Yan Tielong's eyes became sharp when he heard the beautiful adventurer's words and said to the green-skinned horned beast that was competing with him.
"Ah!!!" Yan Tielong roared, increasing the power of his sword, and broke away from the green-skinned horned beast that was competing with him. Before the green-skinned horned beast could stand firm, Yan Tielong pursued with the wind feather swordsmanship, and before the green-skinned horned beast could react, Yan Tielong split it in two from the waist with a sword.
"Wind blade!" At the same time, Yan Tielong's attack was not over. Before cutting the green-skinned horned tooth into two pieces, he was already silently reciting the wind magic spell. After he finished splitting the green-skinned horned beast in two, he directly released the wind magic with his left hand, and released more than a dozen wind blades that accurately passed behind the young man wearing knight armor and shot at the neck of the other green-skinned horned beast without any armor.
The green-skinned horned beast was hit in the neck by Yan Tielong's wind blade, which directly cut off the blood veins in the green-skinned horned beast's neck. The green-skinned horned beast painfully covered its wound with its own hands to prevent the green blood from flowing out. Unfortunately, it was of no use. It couldn't stop it at all, and finally fell down and bled to death.
"Ah~!" The last green-skinned horned beast saw its companion being quickly dispatched by a human. It trembled and roared, then quickly turned around and ran away.
"You think you can still run away, go to hell!" Yan Tielong saw the last green-skinned horned beast running away without looking back, so he picked up the big wooden stick of the dead green-skinned horned beast next to him, and threw it directly at the fleeing green-skinned horned beast.
I don't know whether the green-skinned horned beast was unlucky or Yan Tielong's hit rate was too high. The big wooden stick thrown by Yan Tielong perfectly hit the green-skinned horned beast on the back of the head.After the Leatherhorn Tooth was hit, it ran two steps forward and fell to the ground and fainted.
Yan Tielong looked at the green-skinned horned beast that fell to the ground, walked up to him, and cut off the head of the green-skinned horned beast with a sword, and said: "It is very important to make up for the damage afterwards. Now I have a month or two of living expenses."
"You bloodthirsty maniac! It has no fighting ability, why are you still killing it!" When Yan Tielong walked towards the blonde beauty, the young man "Female" in knight armor asked Yan Tielong who was passing by her in a dissatisfied and questioning tone.
When Yan Tielong heard the question from the young man in knight armor, he stopped and looked deeply at the young man in knight armor and said, "Boy, have you read too many knight novels? And I think you are not suitable for here. Returning to your big city and continuing to be a noble is the right choice for you."
"I want to duel with you!" The young man "Female" wearing knight armor was angry when he heard Yan Tielong's words. He took off his gloves and threw them at Yan Tielong and shouted loudly.
"Haha, when will you be able to deal with more than three green-skinned horned beasts by yourself, come and fight with me. I'm not interested in ravaging rookies, but a noble boy with white hands like you shouldn't be able to reach that level." Yan Tielong picked up the armored gloves on the ground and paid attention to the flawless white hands of the young man wearing knight armor. He smiled and threw the gloves back to the young man wearing knight armor. "Female" said.
"You!" The young man in knight armor looked at Yan Tielong as he passed her and was speechless. After all, she knew the gap between her own strength and the rude adventurer in front of her.
Yan Tielong suddenly saw an unknown little red flower on the ground, picked it directly and came to the beautiful adventurer. He gave the small red flower to the beautiful adventurer and said: "My beautiful lady, this flower is very suitable for you. I hope you like it.".
"Thank you!" The mature blond beauty called Aunt Lan by the young man wearing knight armor took the little red flower, gently smelled the little red flower, and thanked with a smile.
Yan Tielong smiled brightly when he saw the beautiful woman in front of him. A wolf appeared in his heart and roared non-stop. On the surface, he looked very gentlemanly and asked the beautiful woman in front of him: "Beautiful lady, you don't know the proposal I just made. Are you willing to accept my invitation?".
"Sorry! I'm not interested in immature boys. Thank you for the flower." The young man in knight armor called him Aunt Lan. He looked at Yan Tielong's very gentlemanly expression and his expression became serious. He returned the little red flower to Yan Tielong's hand, and then left to walk towards the motorcade.
"Iron Dragon! Iron Dragon!!" When Yan Tielong heard the words of the beauty of his heart, his heart broke into pieces. At the same time, his appearance was shocked to the point of being petrified, and he could not even hear Kermidian running to him and calling his name.
"You deserve it!" The young man "Female" wearing knight armor gloated when he saw Yan Tielong like this as he passed by.
"Xiao Nan! Help me get the water bag." Kemidis shouted to his companions in the convoy when he saw that no matter how he shouted, there was no response.
